status_values.DRAFT_FOR_ROOT_REVIEW_NO_RUNS: no A1 fit and no new synthetic generation
status_values.FROZEN_NONLINEAR_STAGED_AUTHORIZED: stage 1: exactly one A1 development run (nonlinear_a1_dev_v1); stage 2: exactly one fresh simulation run (nonlinear_sim_v1), only after the committed selection record exists. The protocol is not edited between stages.

question: Does a fixed shallow nonlinear gene-and-position model give lower log loss with non-increased Brier than the frozen logistic model, a nonlinear depth-only model and strong copying/averaging controls?
not_claimed: full anatomy, axon geometry or synapses

families.hgbt_position: measured position only (isolates genes beyond nonlinear location)

candidate.model: sklearn 1.8 HistGradientBoostingClassifier, one per target, fixed structure
candidate.adapter: the frozen simulation adapter (analysis/paired_projection_simulation.py fit_view): training-only median fill then training-only StandardScaler; identical for both families
candidate.fit_weights: group-balanced 1/n_group over training cells, mean-normalised; no class_weight
candidate.shrinkage: p' = (1 - alpha) p + alpha q_fit, q_fit = group-balanced captured rate in the training animals only

comparators.simulation_names: the 13 methods of the frozen simulation protocol (same settings; old candidate and raw copy anchors renamed there)

a1_phase.data: BARseq2 A1 598 cells, XC95 and XC97, 11 targets: BOTH mice EXPOSED DEVELOPMENT
a1_phase.loading: frozen runner validate/assemble (exact IDs, masks, targets, canonical order); leave-one-animal-out folds from the frozen runner
a1_phase.baselines: the 13 comparators are reproduced fold-by-fold with the frozen development code; the saved development predictions.csv must contain exactly one row per expected (cell_id, group_id, fold, endpoint, config) key (no duplicates, none missing, no extras), finite probabilities in [0, 1], equal labels, and agree within 1e-12. The all-training deployment artifact is never scored as out-of-fold.
a1_phase.selection: one global alpha per HGBT family, by target-equal (animal-equal within target) log loss, subject to Brier <= that family's own alpha=0 Brier; ties: lower Brier, then larger alpha. All configurations and the unconstrained best are reported.
a1_phase.gate: DEVELOPMENT descriptive: selected hgbt_gene_position must have lower target-equal log loss AND non-increased target-equal Brier than the frozen operational model, the selected hgbt_position, and every strong copy/averaging control. Failures are listed separately. If the gate is not met, the frozen operational model is retained; the nonlinear candidate is still reported and still tested in the simulation phase.
a1_phase.frozen_selection_output: selection.json, written last, binds alphas, selected keys, gate, executing source path and hashes of the executing and imported sources, the run's protocol snapshot, result.json, predictions.csv, RUN_COMPLETE.json and both artifacts

deployment_artifact.what: for each selected HGBT family: per target, the fixed HGBT refit on ALL A1 development rows (both mice) - DEPLOYMENT_REFIT_NOT_OOF
deployment_artifact.saved: artifact_<family>.joblib (our own file) + artifact_<family>.json: training-only median/scaler, q_fit, feature order, fixed parameters, selected alpha, training cell IDs and groups, model file SHA-256
deployment_artifact.loading: metadata and model hashes verified before joblib.load; third-party pickles are never loaded
deployment_artifact.prediction: features only (no labels); numeric 2-D inputs with exact widths and matching rows; finite values; gene counts >= 0 before log1p; outputs pass the reviewed probability check. A1 inputs are complete; the shared median adapter only matters for missing simulation inputs.

simulation_phase.generator: unchanged analysis/paired_projection_simulation.py generate(), 4 scenarios, 6 TRAIN + 4 TEST animals, 100 cells/animal, 16 genes, 4 targets
simulation_phase.case_id: (scenario, seed); required because generator animal/cell IDs repeat across seeds
simulation_phase.fitting: each frozen recipe and each HGBT family (frozen alpha) refit on that case's TRAIN animals only; TEST labels, assay masks, generating probabilities and latent/true states are never passed to preprocessing, eligibility, q_fit, fallback or prediction
simulation_phase.reporting: each case, paired control-minus-candidate differences, means and ranges per scenario and overall; gate result per case; no settings chosen from these outcomes
simulation_phase.saved_cases: each case saved as SYNTHETIC_<scenario>_<seed>.npz (allow_pickle=False compatible; verified by reload): all generator arrays including labels, masks, coordinates, features, generating probabilities and latent states, plus case_id and seed; anchor_receipt.json; every input/output hash in RUN_COMPLETE.json

durability: fixed run IDs and canonical folders; protocol_snapshot.json copied into each run and hashed in STARTED; exclusive STARTED before any data are parsed or generated; keyed raw and shrunk predictions; fit audit; RUN_COMPLETE with executing source and imported module hashes and all output hashes; duplicate run IDs refused; no silent rerun

selection_record.written: only after ROOT replays stage 1; committed before stage 2

content.alphas: {hgbt_gene_position: a, hgbt_position: a} exactly as in selection.json

selection_record.stage2_checks: record committed and unmodified; A1 selection.json and RUN_COMPLETE hashes match; every completed A1 file still matches RUN_COMPLETE; alphas equal and in the grid; executing and imported source hashes equal those recorded in selection.json; fixed HGBT structure equal

checks_before_any_data_is_read_or_genera: protocol status FROZEN_NONLINEAR_STAGED_AUTHORIZED, committed and unmodified; the run uses the canonical protocol path
executing source is the canonical analysis/paired_projection_nonlinear.py (no substitute path), committed and unmodified
imported sources pinned: development code, frozen runner, reference module, simulation code and simulation protocol
published recipe hash and archived candidate recipe hash pinned separately, with identical frozen settings
protocol fixed HGBT parameters, alphas, comparators, run identities and seeds equal the code constants
stage 1 also: A1 input manifest, admission record and saved development predictions hashes
stage 2 also: the committed selection record (see selection_record)
